name: Cookiedeal MCP
description:
Cookiedeal MCP helps Claude search and analyze Korean companies using Cookiedeal data and public disclosure sources. It supports company search, OpenDART disclosure lookup, financial and ownership insights, view-only corporate and real-estate registry PDFs, and authenticated search across the user’s own business-card network.

Some tools use existing Cookiedeal subscription or prepaid usage credits. The connector cannot top up, refund, transfer, or exchange credits. Registry PDFs are provided as view-only access for business review workflows and are not legal certificate issuance.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Cookiedeal MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Cookiedeal MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.cookiedeal.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Cookiedeal MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cookiedeal MCP lists 30 MCP tools, including autocomplete_company, count_my_cards, get_card_detail, get_company_dart_api_data, get_company_dart_financials, get_company_dart_note_detail, get_company_detail_items, get_company_disclosure_events, get_company_executives, get_company_financials, get_company_ownership, and get_company_public_summary.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Cookiedeal MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Cookiedeal MCP in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Cookiedeal MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cookiedeal MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Cookiedeal MCP is developed by Fractal Technology (Cookiedeal). It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
